title: Former Politico journalist asks Brent about Harrington's denial

tellings.quote: November by um a journalist formerly with um Politico, Ben Shiserling

plain: Brent Friedman says that in November a journalist who used to work at Politico, Ben Schreckinger, asked him about a denial from John S. Herrington, a former official who was Secretary of Energy. Friedman tells Michels about the exchange himself but says nothing more about what was denied.
